answers.text: There is no resurrection of the dead
Paul is not a real apostle

questions.question: What did Paul tell the Corinthians would be true of them if Christ had not been raised?

answers.text: They would still be in their sins

questions.question: Paul wrote that if believers hoped in Christ for this life alone, what would be true of them?

answers.text: They should be pitied more than anyone
